subject: HelixAI — dedicated capacity playbook & commitment ask (weekly sync)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@helix.ai>
Cc: procurement@helix.ai, CloudFlux Sales <cloudops@cloudflux.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: HelixAI — dedicated capacity playbook & commitment ask (weekly sync)

Team / Maya —

Following our pipeline readout this morning I wanted to capture a short playbook and firm up the commitment ask for HelixAI so infra/finance can lock a reserve lane for Q1 usage. High-level points: 

- Helix is projecting 3–4x token volume growth starting Jan 15 with a concentrated launch window for new product validation.
- Sales is asking for a committed dedicated pool (NVIDIA A100-equivalent) for predictable latency and offload from shared pools.
- Ops needs a target reserve size today to provision capacity procurement and pricing (blended reserved slot vs. burst credits).

Asks: 
1) Ops: can you confirm a staging-to-prod ramp profile we can show Maya by EOD Tuesday? (We need a 30/60/90-day slot plan)
2) Finance: draft the proposed commit tiers and expected blended unit price for the requested pool so we can share T&Cs with procurement.
3) Sales/Customer (Maya): please confirm whether Helix is comfortable with a Q1 start date (target Jan 15) and the minimum guaranteed tokens per month for tiering.

Attachments: capacity_request_summary.csv (high-level numbers), helix_commit_matrix.xlsx (tier / pricing), dedicated_runbook_v2.pdf (ops runbook stub).

I'll run a quick cross-functional sync on Wednesday 10:00 PT if that works for everyone — 15 minutes to align on numbers and next steps.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

--
attachment: capacity_request_summary.csv (csv)
attachment: helix_commit_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)
attachment: dedicated_runbook_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@helix.ai>
Cc: procurement@helix.ai
Date: 2026-11-01T11:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelixAI — dedicated capacity playbook & commitment ask (weekly sync)

Kimberly — quick readout from infra side.

- Based on Helix's projected 3–4x ramp, recommended reserve: 6 dedicated A100-equivalent slots with ability to burst another 4 slots in first 60 days. This gives ~40% headroom for unpredicted peaks.
- Staging-to-prod ramp: week 0–2: 1 slot (validation); week 2–6: +2 slots (pilot); week 6–12: +3 slots (prod ramp) to reach 6 total by day 90.
- Ops impact: provisioning lead time for hardware reservations is ~6–8 weeks if we go through reserved capacity; cloud marketplace reserved pricing would need finance approval.

I'll prepare a simple CSV with the ramp numbers and cost assumptions (linked in the attachments Kimberly shared). If Helix needs sub-hour burst, we should talk to CloudFlux (cc'd) about burst SLA.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Capacity Planning
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Patel <maya@helix.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@helix.ai
Date: 2026-11-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelixAI — dedicated capacity playbook & commitment ask (weekly sync)

Kimberly / Ben —

Thanks for the clear ask and suggested ramp. Quick responses from Helix: 
- Jan 15 start is our target; we need predictable baseline capacity for model validation and a burst profile for the first 8 weeks.
- Minimum guaranteed tokens (for tiering) — we can commit to 1.2B tokens/month in Q1 with an expectation to move to 3B/month by end of Q1 if early metrics look good.
- Procurement note: we'll need a 60-day internal procurement window from contract signature to payment/PO issuance.

Can you share the cost assumptions for the 6-slot reserve vs. a mixed reserved+burst model? If CloudFlux can provide burst credits with a clear SLA, that may be preferable short-term while we finalize a longer reserved commitment.

Maya Patel
VP, Platform Engineering
Helix.ai

> On Nov 1, 2026, at 11:12 AM, Ben Carter wrote:
> > Kimberly — quick readout from infra side.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Maya Patel <maya@helix.ai>, procurement@helix.ai
Cc: CloudFlux Sales <cloudops@cloudflux.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HelixAI — dedicated capacity playbook & commitment ask (weekly sync)

All —

Summary / Ops confirmation after internal check: 
- We can provision the 6-slot dedicated pool requested, with a preferred go-live window of Jan 10–20 (fits their Jan 15 target).
- Provisioning cadence and cost:
  * Option A (Reserved commit): 6 slots reserved for 12 months — lead time 6–8 weeks, blended unit price = $X.XX/token-equivalent (see attached helix_commit_matrix.xlsx for tier buckets).
  * Option B (Hybrid): 3 reserved slots + burst credits for 4 additional slots on demand — lower upfront commit, small premium on burst tokens.
- Next step for procurement: Redwood legal will prepare a T&C addendum for the reserved slot commitment. Procurement/Maya — please confirm the 60-day procurement window and whether Helix can provide initial PO by Dec 1 to meet Jan provisioning.

I'll attach a short ops runbook excerpt (dedicated_runbook_v2.pdf) that outlines provisioning steps, monitoring hooks, and fallback policy (auto-fallback to shared pool with rate-limited tokens if dedicated fails).

If everyone is aligned, Kimberly — please go ahead and schedule the 15-minute sync Wednesday 11/04 10:00 PT so we can finalize the decision and action items.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
VP, Infrastructure Operations
Redwood Inference
